questions.ask: What behaviour changes for a reviewer of the private invitation report, and for whom?
questions.key: Each selected invitation row shows a read-only date_added taken from the matched Supabase prospect row, so the report reader sees when the prospect was first added.
key_facts: date_added is read only from created_at on exactly one canonical-profile-matched Supabase prospect row
missing, malformed, timezone-naive or future timestamps stay unknown with a fixed reason
it never affects shortlist eligibility, ranking, exclusions or capacity
